jobs.occupation: Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders), Österreichische Rundfunksender GmbH (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept. You translate your findings into clear, digestible formats and share your knowledge internally and externally -- through technical blog posts, presentations, or trend and technology analyses. AI and automation are a permanent part of your technology radar -- always with an eye on concrete use cases in the streaming and platform environment. Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You lead the operational activities of BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You make sure PoC outcomes are properly documented and turned into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You continuously improve our Lab processes, fostering an agile, execution-oriented innovation culture. Note: This requirement must be fulfilled by February 7, 2027 at the latest.· Good academic record· Good knowledge in at least one of the fields data analysis, quantitative economics, econometrics and/or statistics· Proficiency and ability to teach in English or German· (Preferably strong) experience in scientific programming (e.g., Python, R or MATLAB)This distinguishes you additionally:· First experiences in academic teaching and research· First experiences in quantitative economics or similar fields· Strong interest in developing theoretical results· Dedication to research in economics, econometrics or quantitative economics· Proficiency and ability to teach in both English and German· Strong motivation and output orientation· Ability to work independently in (scientific) projects with a focus on high quality and precision Application:· via our https://jobs.aau.at/en/job/university-assistant-predoctoral-all-genders-welcome-in-german-universitaetsassistentin-4/ under the reference code 465/26 no later than November 18, 2026· Applicants who meet the required qualification but have not completed their Master's/Diploma degree can apply, provided they are able to meet this requirement by by February 7, 2027.· Contact address: Christina Kopetzky (QED@aau.at) The University of Klagenfurt strives to increase the proportion of women in all areas where they are underrepresented and expressly encourages qualified women to apply. The University of Klagenfurt is committed to anti-discrimination, equal opportunities, and diversity. People with disabilities and/or chronic illnesses who meet the required qualification criteria are expressly encouraged to apply. For full details of this vacancy and the application procedure, please see https://jobs.aau.at/en/job/university-assistant-predoctoral-all-genders-welcome-in-german-universitaetsassistentin-4/. Das Mindestentgelt für die Stelle als University assistant predoctoral (all genders welcome) (in German: Universitätsassistent:in)Reference code: 465/26 beträgt 52.865,40 EUR brutto pro Jahr auf Basis Vollzeitbeschäftigung.
